description: Fires when the opponent has three of their stones stacked vertically at the top of a column with the cell above still empty (a vertical must-block). Column 5 is by far the strongest (huge activation, especially right after the third stone lands); columns 1 and 6 fire moderately, 0/2/4 only sometimes, column 3 almost never. Horizontal or diagonal threats rarely fire it; my own three does not; having my own immediate win weakens it.
effect: Pushes the model to play column 5: forcing it to max sends column 5 to ~100% even when the correct block or best move is elsewhere; turning it off on a column-5 vertical block lowers column 5 by up to ~20 points.
notes: Core (opponent vertical open three in col 5) has precision ~0.99 but covers only 27% of firing. Adding other columns' vertical threes gives F1 0.55-0.56 (best p6: F1 0.557, P 0.445, R 0.744, AUROC 0.858, sim 72.8%). Any must-block gives recall 0.90 but precision 0.18. Weak firings outside column 5 are context-dependent and not cleanly explained; column weighting was found by act tests.
